subject: Hosted API evaluation  quickstart, endpoints, and rate limits
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo - Hosted API evaluation & next steps

Hi Sarah -

Thanks again for your time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get your team a Hosted API proof-of-concept: 

What we covered
- Demo of Redwood Hosted API (text generation, chat, embeddings).
- How routing and fallback work for reliability, and our Dedicated/Private options for later stages.

Your stated goals
- Quick POC to validate integration with your personalization pipeline.
- Keep data in the cloud for now (no on-prem requirement for POC).
- Want guidance on throughput/rate limits and cost before engineering spends effort.

Next steps we recommend
1) Quickstart: I attached our concise quickstart guide and the demo recording (link below). Marissa can spin up a temporary API key and a sandbox workspace for your engineers.
2) Traffic profile: Could you share expected QPS (or requests/min) and typical prompt / response token sizes for the POC? That will help us recommend batching/limits and the best model variant.
3) Security checkpoints: Dev, copying you - any immediate must-haves (IP allowlist, VPC, SOC2 evidence) we should surface now?
4) Schedule: Would you be available for a 30-minute technical walkthrough next week to set up the sandbox and run a test? Here are two windows I have: Tue 12/08 10-11am PT or Wed 12/09 2-3pm PT.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf
Links: https://console.redwood.ai/quickstart (quickstart), demo recording: https://drive.redwood.ai/recordings/demo-20261202.mp4

Happy to tailor the sandbox to whatever team you want to include (engineering, data science).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Note: For POC we usually recommend Hosted API to move quickly. If longer-term you need dedicated throughput or VPC control, we can discuss Redwood Dedicated or Private options later in the funnel.

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeretail.com>

Subject: Re: Demo - Hosted API evaluation & next steps

Thanks, Aditya - and thanks to Marissa as well for the demo.

We are definitely leaning toward Hosted for the POC so we can iterate quickly. A few questions from the engineering and security teams before we kick off the sandbox:

- Endpoints: what base URLs should our engineers use (chat vs generation vs embeddings)?
- Rate limits: what are the default limits (requests/min, tokens/min) and is bursting supported? Can limits be increased for the POC?
- Concurrency: how many concurrent streams/requests per API key?
- IP allowlisting / allowlist of callback URLs - supported?
- Authentication: API keys only, or do you support mTLS or token-based sessions?
- Cost: rough estimate for a small POC (10k tokens/day average) so we can get a budget-holder signoff.

Also, can you send over SOC2 docs (or summary) and your data retention defaults? IT has asked for that before we hand over any sample data.

If it helps, we can do a technical walkthrough with our backend lead and security lead on Wednesday.

Thanks,
Sarah Jones
Senior Product Manager, Personalization | Acme Retail
sarah.jones@acmeretail.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo - Hosted API evaluation & next steps

Sarah - great questions. High level answers below; Marissa will add technical detail and we can provision a sandbox asap.

Endpoints
- REST base: https://api.redwood.ai/v1 (generation/chat/embeddings are route paths; quickstart has example curl and SDK snippets). Streaming chat is available at /v1/chat/stream.

Rate limits / concurrency
- Default Hosted rate limits: 120 requests/min per API key and 10 concurrent streaming connections.
- Token throughput: soft limit of ~500k tokens/min per workspace; POCs are never limited at the per-token level for small usage - we can increase limits temporarily if you expect higher bursts.
- Bursting: short bursts are supported; sustained higher throughput is handled via Dedicated pools.

Auth & network controls
- Auth: API keys for Hosted; we support IP allowlisting for API keys and per-account allowlist rules. For mTLS/VPC you would move to Dedicated or Private.
- Data retention: by default, PII is not logged by model training pipelines; we retain telemetry for 30 days. We can configure retention windows for enterprise customers.

SOC2 / compliance
- Attached is a SOC2 summary (SOC2-summary.pdf). For full evidence our security team can start an evidence sharing workflow once you're in a contract.

Cost estimate (very rough)
- For a small POC (~10k tokens/day): estimate <$100/month on Hosted depending on model choice. We can provide a more precise estimate with expected prompt/response sizes.

Next actions
- Marissa: can you provision a sandbox workspace + temporary API key for Acme? Please include a sample Postman collection and SDK snippets.
- Sarah: if you can share expected QPS and a few example prompts, we'll pre-configure batching and model selection.
- Aditya: I'll send over a calendar invite for a 30-minute technical walkthrough; please propose times.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya

Hi Sarah - I can take care of the sandbox provisioning this morning. Quick tech notes to help your backend lead: 

- Tokens / model guidance: for personalization prompts we typically recommend a 4-16k context model for relevant context; for small POCs a 8k model balances cost and quality.
- Recommended batching: enable 50-100ms artificial batching in your client to improve throughput for many short prompts; Marissa will send example batching config.
- Streaming: streaming chat supports chunked responses; limit to 10 concurrent streams per API key to keep latency stable.
- IP allowlist: we can add your IP ranges to the API key on request (Hosted). For private VPC, full network control is available with Redwood Private.

I'll provision:
- A sandbox workspace for Acme Retail
- A temporary API key with default Hosted limits (120 rpm, 10 concurrent streams)
- Postman collection + Node/Python SDK examples

Please confirm who from your team we should invite to the workspace (emails) and whether you prefer the sandbox in us-west region.

Dev - can you confirm the SOC2 summary here is sufficient to unblock initial testing? If we need to raise an evidence share ticket, happy to do that.

Sarah - I'll send the workspace invite and sample keys once you confirm the test users; we can then do the technical walkthrough and run a couple of integration tests end-to-end.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
